column2: Tabāraka ladhi biyadihi l-mulku wahuwa ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīr
Alladhi khalaqa l-mawta walḥayawāta liyabluwakum ʾayyukum ʾaḥsanu ʿamalan wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ghafūr
Alladhi khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqan mā tarā fi khalqi r-raḥmāni min tafāwutin farjiʿi l-baṣara hal tarā min fuṭūr
Thumma rjiʿi l-baṣara karratayni yanqalib ʾilayka l-baṣaru khāsiʾan wahuwa ḥasīr
Walaqad zayyannā s-samāʾa d-dunyā bimaṣābīḥa wajaʿalnāhā rujūman lilshshayāṭīni waʾaʿtadnā lahum ʿadhāba s-saʿīr
Walilladhīna kafarū birabbihim ʿadhābu jahannama wabiʾsa l-maṣīr
ʾidhā ʾulqū fīhā samiʿū lahā shahīqan wahiya tafūr
Takādu tamayyazu mina l-ghayẓi kullamā ʾulqiya fīhā fawjun saʾalahum khazanatuhā ʾalam yaʾtikum nadhīr
Qālū balā qad jāʾanā nadhīrun fakadhdhabnā waqulnā mā nazzala llāhu min shāʾin ʾin ʾantum ʾillā fi ḍalālin kabīr
Waqālū law kunnā nasmaʿu ʾaw naʿqilu mā kunnā fi ʾaṣḥābi s-saʿīr
Faʿtarafū bidhanbihim fasuḥqan liʾaṣḥābi s-saʿīr
ʾinna ladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bilghaybi lahum maghfiratun waʾajrun kabīr
Waʾasirrū qawlakum ʾawi jharū bihi ʾinnahu ʿalīmun bidhāti ṣ-ṣudūr
ʾalā yaʿlamu man khalaqa wahuwa l-laṭīfu l-khabīr
Huwa ladhi jaʿala lakumu l-ʾarḍa dhalūlan famshū fi manākibihā wakulū min rizqihi waʾilayhi n-nushūr
ʾaʾamintum man fi s-samāʾi ʾan yakhsifa bikumu l-ʾarḍa faʾidhā hiya tamūr
ʾam ʾamintum man fi s-samāʾi ʾan yursila ʿalaykum ḥāṣiban fasataʿlamūna kayfa nadhīr
Walaqad kadhdhaba ladhīna min qablihim fakayfa kāna nakīr
ʾawalam yaraw ʾilā ṭ-ṭayri fawqahum ṣāffātin wayaqbiḍna mā yumsikuhunna ʾillā r-raḥmānu ʾinnahu bikulli shāʾin baṣīr
ʾamman hādhā ladhi huwa jundun lakum yanṣurukum min dūni r-raḥmāni ʾini l-kāfirūna ʾillā fi ghurūr
ʾamman hādhā ladhi yarzuqukum ʾin ʾamsaka rizqahu bal lajjū fi ʿutuwwin wanufūr
ʾafaman yamshi mukibban ʿalā wajhihi ʾahdā ʾamman yamshi sawiyyan ʿalā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm
Qul huwa ladhi ʾanshaʾakum wajaʿala lakumu s-samʿa walʾabṣāra walʾafidata qalīlan mā tashkurūn
Qul huwa ladhi dharaʾakum fi l-ʾarḍi waʾilayhi tuḥsharūn
Wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīn
Qul ʾinnamā l-ʿilmu ʿinda llāhi waʾinnamā ʾanā nadhīrun mubīn
Falammā raʾawhu zulfatan siyat wujūhu ladhīna kafarū waqīla hādhā ladhi kuntum bihi taddaʿūn
Qul ʾaraʾaytum ʾin ʾahlakaniya llāhu waman maʿiya ʾaw raḥimanā faman yujīru l-kāfirīna min ʿadhābin ʾalīm
Qul huwa r-raḥmānu ʾāmannā bihi waʿalayhi tawakkalnā fasataʿlamūna man huwa fi ḍalālin mubīn
Qul ʾaraʾaytum ʾin ʾaṣbaḥa māʾukum ghawran faman yaʾtīkum bimāʾin maʿīn
